matthew.3.p1.b1.text: In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea

matthew.3.p1.b2.text: and saying, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.”

matthew.3.p1.b3.text: This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness,

matthew.3.p1.b4.text: ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.’”

matthew.3.p2.b1.text: John wore a garment of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

matthew.3.p2.b2.text: People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea and the whole region around the Jordan.

matthew.3.p2.b3.text: Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.

matthew.3.p3.b1.text: But when John saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his place of baptism, he said to them,

matthew.3.p3.b2.text: “You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?

matthew.3.p3.b3.text: And do not presume to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’

matthew.3.p3.b4.text: For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.

matthew.3.p4.b1.text: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.

matthew.3.p4.b2.text: but after me will come One more powerful than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry.

matthew.3.p4.b3.text: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather His wheat into the barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

matthew.3.p5.b1.text: At that time Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.

matthew.3.p5.b2.text: But John tried to prevent Him, saying,

matthew.3.p5.b3.text: “I need to be baptized by You, and do You come to me?”

matthew.3.p6.b1.text: “Let it be so now, … It is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness in this way.”

matthew.3.p6.b3.text: As soon as Jesus was baptized, He went up out of the water.

matthew.3.p7.b2.text: and He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and resting on Him.

matthew.3.p7.b3.text: And a voice from heaven said,

matthew.3.p7.b4.text: “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!”
